title: Jewelled Indian Apricot Paratha Bread
description: A floral, light, and festive Indian dish featuring apricot and a paratha bread form that is perfect for special occasions.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, cardamom powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the milk, yogurt, sugar, and ghee or oil.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a soft dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Cover the dough with a damp cloth and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal portions.
Roll out each portion into a thin circle.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Place a rolled-out dough circle in the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Flip the paratha and cook for another 1-2 minutes.
Assemble the Jewelled Indian Apricot Paratha Bread by placing a dollop of apricot on one half of the paratha, followed by a sprinkle of chopped nuts and dried rose petals.
Fold the other half of the paratha over the filling and press the edges together to seal.
Repeat with the remaining dough and filling ingredients.
Serve warm with a dollop of yogurt or a sprinkle of sugar, if desired.
